name: verification
description: Track a sign-in code (open|satisfy|abandon|list). Call open as soon as a sign-in shows a code screen, BEFORE asking the principal or delegating an inbox read. Choose email delivery when offered unless the masked address isn't the principal's; tick 'remember this device'. Call satisfy once the site accepts the code. Never pass a code here.

outputs.reused: boolean? (open only: true = the site already had a pending verification for this errand)
outputs.superseded: object? (open only: another task's pending verification on this site, now abandoned)
outputs.note: string? (open only: present when superseded is)
outputs.ask_channel: string? (open only: channel to ask the principal on, or null)
